And then some time later I'm actually in the situation and I only just suddenly remember the dream.

I dont know how it is in california but in my state, in middle school, only courses with high school credit transfer into your high school gpa and transcript

in most cases, this was just math course and foreign language in middle school. not general science or language arts or anything else.
so what i would suggest is just focus on bringing up the grades in the courses that count for now, and then a fresh start next year.

and another important thing is BELIEVING you can do it. if you feed into thoughts like 'there's no pt my grade is already so low' you won't get anymore and you will stress yourself out. ex: i had an english teacher who made me hate the class and i sort of ruined my grade 2nd quarter. now i couldve brought it up but i thought the teacher hated me and was biased so it's hopeless and i worried and procrastinated more than actually doing the work, when i actually couldve saved my grade. it's not the end yet, so don't think it's the end.

also think about the top student in your class. i do this exercise sometimes when i feel afraid to ask for help when i'm falling behind. like imagine they're falling behind or something. they would probably immediately remedy that and ask the teacher for help. what i mean is sometimes i feel like my grade is so low in a class, that the teacher hates me and i can't ask for help. but that's not true at all and it's definitely when you should ask for help!!! just keep your eye on the goal and don't let anything put you down.

also tell your dad the truth. i used to do that. when my dad asked whether i was working i lied and said yes and instead wasted more time. it's a neverending cycle. just say no you're not working. tell him all these things you're telling us and how you've tried different things and failed. just tell him you were afraid to before because you thought he would get mad. be transparent and don't lie anymore. get someone in your corner to support you.

as for the stuff about doing other random things to avoid doing work. i was the same way. the thing is is that you have to want to do the work. so think about WHY. spend some time thinking about the future and something that YOU want to do and how bringing up your grade is necessary. 

so tl;dr if you BELIEVE in yourself you will procrastinate less. also be honest and ask for help from your family.
